question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Gentle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sympathetic**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Gentle **means kind, mild, or tender. (दयालु, सौम्य या कोमल)

 
 
• **Example**: *She spoke to the scared child in a gentle voice, trying to calm him down.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Sympathetic **means showing understanding or compassion. (समझ या करुणा दिखाना)
 
 
• **Example**:* She was always sympathetic towards others' struggles.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that 'Sympathetic' is the appropriate synonym for 'Gentle'.

Thus, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fierce **means aggressive or violent. (आक्रामक या हिंसक)
 
• **Ferocious **means savagely fierce or cruel. (अत्यधिक भयंकर या क्रूर)
 
• **Cruel **means causing pain or suffering intentionally. (जानबूझकर दर्द या पीड़ा पहुंचाना)
